# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable and widely supported environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, MPI, and utilities
# ca-certificates is included for secure network operations (e.g., git, wget)
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    gfortran \
    git \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for container environments by excluding loopback and docker bridge interfaces
# This is a common practice to ensure MPI traffic is routed correctly in container orchestrators.
RUN echo "btl_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "oob_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf

# Set a consistent build directory
WORKDIR /build

# Build and install METIS 4.0.3 from source
# The specified OPTFLAGS are required to handle implicit function declaration warnings as errors.
RUN wget --no-check-certificate https://github.com/mfem/tpls/raw/gh-pages/metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzvf metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    cd metis-4.0.3 && \
    make OPTFLAGS="-Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration" && \
    make install && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf metis-4.0.3 metis-4.0.3.tar.gz

# Build and install HYPRE 2.28.0 from source
# Fortran is disabled and bigint is enabled as per requirements for compatibility with the stack.
RUN wget --no-check-certificate https://github.com/hypre-space/hypre/archive/refs/tags/v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzvf v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    cd hypre-2.28.0/src && \
    ./configure --disable-fortran --enable-bigint && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install && \
    cd ../.. && \
    rm -rf hypre-2.28.0 v2.28.0.tar.gz

# Build and install MFEM 4.7 from source
# The build is configured for parallel execution with MPI and linked against the previously built HYPRE and METIS.
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    cd mfem && \
    git checkout v4.7 && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc) MFEM_USE_MPI=YES HYPRE_DIR=/usr/local METIS_DIR=/usr/local && \
    make install && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf mfem

# Build the Laghos application from source
# The build links against the previously installed MFEM library.
RUN git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git && \
    cd Laghos && \
    make -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=/usr/local

# Copy the final executable to a location on the system's PATH
# This makes the application directly runnable without specifying its full path.
RUN cp /build/Laghos/laghos /usr/local/bin/

# Set the final working directory to the Laghos source directory
# This ensures that the required 'data' directory is readily accessible at runtime.
WORKDIR /build/Laghos

# Set a default command to start an interactive shell
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable and widely supported environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, MPI, and utilities
# ca-certificates is included for secure network operations (e.g., git, wget)
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    gfortran \
    git \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for container environments by excluding loopback and docker bridge interfaces
# This is a common practice to ensure MPI traffic is routed correctly in container orchestrators.
RUN echo "btl_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "oob_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf

# Set a consistent build directory
WORKDIR /build

# Build and install METIS 4.0.3 from source
# This version's Makefile lacks an 'install' target.
# FIX: Manually copy the library and header to standard system locations.
RUN wget --no-check-certificate https://github.com/mfem/tpls/raw/gh-pages/metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzvf metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    cd metis-4.0.3 && \
    make OPTFLAGS="-Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration" && \
    cp libmetis.a /usr/local/lib/ && \
    cp Lib/metis.h /usr/local/include/ && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf metis-4.0.3 metis-4.0.3.tar.gz

# Build and install HYPRE 2.28.0 from source
# Fortran is disabled and bigint is enabled as per requirements for compatibility with the stack.
RUN wget --no-check-certificate https://github.com/hypre-space/hypre/archive/refs/tags/v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzvf v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    cd hypre-2.28.0/src && \
    ./configure --disable-fortran --enable-bigint && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install && \
    cd ../.. && \
    rm -rf hypre-2.28.0 v2.28.0.tar.gz

# Build and install MFEM 4.7 from source
# The build is configured for parallel execution with MPI and linked against the previously built HYPRE and METIS.
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    cd mfem && \
    git checkout v4.7 && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc) MFEM_USE_MPI=YES HYPRE_DIR=/usr/local METIS_DIR=/usr/local && \
    make install && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf mfem

# Build the Laghos application from source
# The build links against the previously installed MFEM library.
RUN git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git && \
    cd Laghos && \
    make -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=/usr/local

# Copy the final executable to a location on the system's PATH
# This makes the application directly runnable without specifying its full path.
RUN cp /build/Laghos/laghos /usr/local/bin/

# Set the final working directory to the Laghos source directory
# This ensures that the required 'data' directory is readily accessible at runtime.
WORKDIR /build/Laghos

# Set a default command to start an interactive shell
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable and widely supported environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, MPI, and utilities
# ca-certificates is included for secure network operations (e.g., git, wget)
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    gfortran \
    git \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for container environments by excluding loopback and docker bridge interfaces
# This is a common practice to ensure MPI traffic is routed correctly in container orchestrators.
RUN echo "btl_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "oob_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf

# Set a consistent build directory
WORKDIR /build

# Build and install METIS 4.0.3 from source
# This version's Makefile lacks an 'install' target, so we manually copy the library and header.
RUN wget --no-check-certificate https://github.com/mfem/tpls/raw/gh-pages/metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzvf metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    cd metis-4.0.3 && \
    make OPTFLAGS="-Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration" && \
    cp libmetis.a /usr/local/lib/ && \
    cp Lib/metis.h /usr/local/include/ && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf metis-4.0.3 metis-4.0.3.tar.gz

# Build and install HYPRE 2.28.0 from source
# Fortran is disabled and bigint is enabled as per requirements.
# FIX: Compile HYPRE with MPI support by specifying CC=mpicc for compatibility with parallel MFEM.
RUN wget --no-check-certificate https://github.com/hypre-space/hypre/archive/refs/tags/v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzvf v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    cd hypre-2.28.0/src && \
    CC=mpicc ./configure --disable-fortran --enable-bigint && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install && \
    cd ../.. && \
    rm -rf hypre-2.28.0 v2.28.0.tar.gz

# Build and install MFEM 4.7 from source
# The build is configured for parallel execution with MPI and linked against the previously built HYPRE and METIS.
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    cd mfem && \
    git checkout v4.7 && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc) MFEM_USE_MPI=YES HYPRE_DIR=/usr/local METIS_DIR=/usr/local && \
    make install && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf mfem

# Build the Laghos application from source
# The build links against the previously installed MFEM library.
RUN git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git && \
    cd Laghos && \
    make -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=/usr/local

# Copy the final executable to a location on the system's PATH
# This makes the application directly runnable without specifying its full path.
RUN cp /build/Laghos/laghos /usr/local/bin/

# Set the final working directory to the Laghos source directory
# This ensures that the required 'data' directory is readily accessible at runtime.
WORKDIR /build/Laghos

# Set a default command to start an interactive shell
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

    CC=mpicc CXX=mpicxx ./configure --disable-fortran --enable-bigint && \

# Set the final working directory to the Laghos source directory
# This ensures that the required 'data' directory is readily accessible at runtime.
WORKDIR /build/Laghos

# Set a default command to start an interactive shell
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable and widely supported environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, MPI, and utilities
# ca-certificates is included for secure network operations (e.g., git, wget)
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    gfortran \
    git \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for container environments by excluding loopback and docker bridge interfaces
# This is a common practice to ensure MPI traffic is routed correctly in container orchestrators.
RUN echo "btl_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "oob_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf

# Set a consistent build directory
WORKDIR /build

# Build and install METIS 4.0.3 from source
# This version's Makefile lacks an 'install' target, so we manually copy the library and header.
RUN wget --no-check-certificate https://github.com/mfem/tpls/raw/gh-pages/metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzvf metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    cd metis-4.0.3 && \
    make OPTFLAGS="-Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration" && \
    cp libmetis.a /usr/local/lib/ && \
    cp Lib/metis.h /usr/local/include/ && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf metis-4.0.3 metis-4.0.3.tar.gz

# Build and install HYPRE 2.28.0 from source
# Fortran is disabled and bigint is enabled as per requirements.
# FIX: Explicitly set the install prefix to /usr/local to ensure MFEM can find HYPRE headers.
RUN wget --no-check-certificate https://github.com/hypre-space/hypre/archive/refs/tags/v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzvf v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    cd hypre-2.28.0/src && \
    CC=mpicc CXX=mpicxx ./configure --prefix=/usr/local --disable-fortran --enable-bigint && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install && \
    cd ../.. && \
    rm -rf hypre-2.28.0 v2.28.0.tar.gz

# Build and install MFEM 4.7 from source
# The build is configured for parallel execution with MPI and linked against the previously built HYPRE and METIS.
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    cd mfem && \
    git checkout v4.7 && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc) MFEM_USE_MPI=YES HYPRE_DIR=/usr/local METIS_DIR=/usr/local && \
    make install && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf mfem

# Build the Laghos application from source
# The build links against the previously installed MFEM library.
RUN git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git && \
    cd Laghos && \
    make -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=/usr/local

# Copy the final executable to a location on the system's PATH
# This makes the application directly runnable without specifying its full path.
RUN cp /build/Laghos/laghos /usr/local/bin/

# Set the final working directory to the Laghos source directory
# This ensures that the required 'data' directory is readily accessible at runtime.
WORKDIR /build/Laghos

# Set a default command to start an interactive shell
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable and widely supported environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, MPI, and utilities
# ca-certificates is included for secure network operations (e.g., git, wget)
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    gfortran \
    git \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for container environments by excluding loopback and docker bridge interfaces
# This is a common practice to ensure MPI traffic is routed correctly in container orchestrators.
RUN echo "btl_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "oob_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf

# Set a consistent build directory
WORKDIR /build

# Build and install METIS 4.0.3 from source
# This version's Makefile lacks an 'install' target, so we manually copy the library and header.
RUN wget --no-check-certificate https://github.com/mfem/tpls/raw/gh-pages/metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzvf metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    cd metis-4.0.3 && \
    make OPTFLAGS="-Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration" && \
    cp libmetis.a /usr/local/lib/ && \
    cp Lib/metis.h /usr/local/include/ && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf metis-4.0.3 metis-4.0.3.tar.gz

# Build and install HYPRE 2.28.0 from source
# Explicitly set the install prefix to /usr/local to ensure MFEM can find HYPRE headers.
RUN wget --no-check-certificate https://github.com/hypre-space/hypre/archive/refs/tags/v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzvf v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    cd hypre-2.28.0/src && \
    CC=mpicc CXX=mpicxx ./configure --prefix=/usr/local --disable-fortran --enable-bigint && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install && \
    cd ../.. && \
    rm -rf hypre-2.28.0 v2.28.0.tar.gz

# Build MFEM 4.7 and then Laghos in a single layer.
# FIX: Link Laghos directly against the MFEM build directory (../mfem) instead of a system install.
# This is a more robust build pattern that avoids potential library path issues.
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    cd mfem && \
    git checkout v4.7 && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc) MFEM_USE_MPI=YES HYPRE_DIR=/usr/local METIS_DIR=/usr/local && \
    cd .. && \
    git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git && \
    cd Laghos && \
    make -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=../mfem && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf mfem

# Copy the final executable to a location on the system's PATH
# This makes the application directly runnable without specifying its full path.
RUN cp /build/Laghos/laghos /usr/local/bin/

# Set the final working directory to the Laghos source directory
# This ensures that the required 'data' directory is readily accessible at runtime.
WORKDIR /build/Laghos

# Set a default command to start an interactive shell
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

flux-minicluster-manifest
# This manifest corrects a previous attempt to run a Laghos experiment.
# It addresses a 'file not found' error and an incorrect field placement.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name and namespace remain unchanged for this experiment.
  name: laghos-cpu-experiment
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The MiniCluster size is 1, ensuring all tasks run on a single Kubernetes node.
  size: 1

  # The total number of MPI tasks for the job.
  tasks: 64

  # Pods will be automatically deleted upon job completion.
  cleanup: true

  # FIX: The nodeSelector was incorrectly nested in the previous version.
  # It is now correctly placed directly under the spec to target specific AWS hardware.
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: "hpc7g.16xlarge"

  # Specifies a custom Flux container image compatible with the target ARM64 architecture.
  flux:
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Defines the primary application container.
  containers:
    - # The container image is unchanged.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:laghos

      # FIX: The primary error was 'Mesh file not found'. The command has been corrected
      # to include the 'data/' prefix, providing the correct relative path to the mesh file
      # from the container's working directory.
      command: laghos -p 1 -m data/cube_311_hex.mesh -pa

      # The container is a worker, not a launcher.
      launcher: false

  # Ensures strict validation of the MiniCluster spec.
  logging:
    strict: true

# This manifest corrects a previous failure by applying debugging settings to a properly structured MiniCluster.
# It ignores the incorrect Job manifest provided in the prompt and instead applies the debugging intent
# to the correct MiniCluster resource type.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name and namespace remain consistent for this experiment.
  name: laghos-cpu-experiment
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The MiniCluster size is 1, ensuring all tasks run on a single Kubernetes node.
  size: 1

  # The total number of MPI tasks for the job.
  tasks: 64

  # Ensures strict validation of the MiniCluster spec.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # FIX: To aid in debugging, cleanup is disabled. This prevents the operator from
  # deleting the pod upon completion or failure, allowing for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # FIX: The job will be marked as failed after one unsuccessful attempt.
  # This avoids unnecessary retries for a job that is likely to fail repeatedly.
  backoffLimit: 1

  # Pod-level specifications for the underlying Indexed Job.
  pod:
    # FIX: The restart policy is set to 'Never'. This ensures that a failed container's pod
    # is preserved in a 'Failed' state for post-mortem analysis of logs and events.
    restartPolicy: Never

    # The nodeSelector correctly schedules the job on the specified ARM-based instance type.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: "hpc7g.16xlarge"

  # Specifies a custom Flux container image compatible with the target ARM64 architecture.
  flux:
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Defines the primary application container.
  containers:
    - # The container image is unchanged.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:laghos

      # Retains the corrected command with the proper relative path to the mesh file.
      command: laghos -p 1 -m data/cube_311_hex.mesh -pa

      # The container is a worker, not a launcher.
      launcher: false

# This manifest re-applies critical debugging settings to diagnose a job failure.
# The previous attempt timed out due to a restart loop, which these settings are designed to prevent.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name and namespace are unchanged.
  name: laghos-cpu-experiment
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The job size and task count are maintained from the previous configuration.
  size: 1
  tasks: 48

  # FIX: The job will be marked as failed after one unsuccessful pod attempt.
  # This prevents the restart loop that caused the timeout.
  backoffLimit: 1

  # FIX: Cleanup is set to false. This is crucial for debugging, as it ensures
  # the pod and its logs are preserved after the job fails.
  cleanup: false

  # Pod-level specifications for the underlying Indexed Job.
  pod:
    # FIX: The restart policy is set to 'Never'. This stops Kubernetes from deleting
    # and recreating the pod on failure, allowing for post-mortem inspection.
    restartPolicy: Never

    # The nodeSelector remains targeted at the c7a.12xlarge instance.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: "c7a.12xlarge"

  # The application container definition is unchanged.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:laghos
      command: laghos -p 1 -m data/cube_311_hex.mesh -pa
      launcher: false

  # Strict logging remains enabled for spec validation.
  logging:
    strict: true

Decision 3: STOP

Agent's Rationale: Peak performance of 128.62 was achieved on the 64-core hpc7g.16xlarge (ARM) instance. A subsequent run on a 48-core AMD instance yielded a lower score (101.73). The ARM architecture appears optimal for this workload, and further gains with other available, lower-core-count instances are unlikely.
